zh.title: 刀斧／双持
zh.description: 武器类别之一，开场任务即可接触。

en.title: Dual Wield
en.description: One of the weapon classes, introduced in the opening mission.

en.title: Greatsword
en.description: One of the three weapon classes.

en.title: Spear
en.description: One of the three weapon classes.

zh.title: 常用套装：用途与获取
zh.description: 以下是常用套装速查，不是全部装备图鉴。英文名用于对照物品栏，中文译名以游戏内显示为准。

en.title: Useful gear sets: roles and acquisition
en.description: This is a selection of useful sets, not a complete equipment catalogue. English names help match inventory entries.

zh.title: 英雄武器与防具套装
zh.description: 豪华版专属奖励，包含三类武器与防具。它不是普通流程中的掉落；套装加成按穿戴件数触发。

en.title: Hero's weapon and armor set
en.description: A Deluxe Edition bonus with all three weapon classes and armor pieces. It is not a standard mission drop; set bonuses depend on equipped pieces.

zh.title: 基础战斗：防御、闪避与资源管理
zh.description: 从精力和斗志开始，区分普通防御、即时防御、闪避、反击与反射，并按步骤练习。

en.title: Combat basics: defense, evasion and resources
en.description: Learn stamina and Spirit, distinguish defensive actions, and follow a practical training order.

zh.title: 技能选择与重置
zh.description: 先区分武器专属技能与通用能力。树上的前置连线、等级要求、技能点与装备附加效果需要分别检查；装备提供的招式不代表所有角色都已永久学会。

en.title: Skill selection and resets
en.description: Distinguish weapon-specific skills from shared abilities. Check prerequisite links, level requirements, points and gear-granted effects separately; a move supplied by equipment is not necessarily permanently learned.

zh.title: 技能重置
zh.description: 支持随时重置和重新分配技能点。

en.title: Skill reset
en.description: Skill points can be reset and reassigned at any time.

zh.title: 死亡后取回 Lacrima
zh.description: 倒下后可以返回死亡地点取回失去的 Lacrima。

en.title: Recovering Lacrima
en.description: Return to the place of death to recover lost Lacrima.

zh.title: 幻影形态
zh.description: 击败敌人、使用特定攻击与技能可积累变身量表。

en.title: Phantom Form
en.description: Defeating enemies and using specific attacks and skills builds the transformation gauge.

zh.title: 新游戏＋：进入前检查与继承
zh.description: 通关后可以先回到裂隙继续处理原周目的内容。想补任务、收集或成就时，先完成清理，再与 Blade Phantom 交互开始新游戏＋。

en.title: New Game+: preparation and carryover
en.description: After the ending, return to the Crevice to finish remaining content in the current journey. When ready, interact with the Blade Phantom to begin New Game+.

zh.title: 装备养成与预设
zh.description: 优先检查武器的实际攻击、等级和适合自己的动作，再比较稀有度。防具同时检查重量带来的负担，避免为套装效果牺牲已经适应的闪避节奏。

en.title: Equipment progression and presets
en.description: Compare weapon attack, level and usable moves before rarity alone. Check armor weight and its effect on your preferred dodge rhythm.

zh.title: 三种武器的配装思路
zh.description: 先判断当前失败原因：伤害不足、精力不够、防御不熟，还是贪刀。属性、套装、技能分别解决不同问题，不宜直接照抄只展示面板伤害的方案。

en.title: Build directions for all three weapons
en.description: Identify whether the issue is damage, stamina, defensive timing or overcommitting. Stats, gear and skills solve different problems.

zh.title: 终极挑战：两种模式与奖励
zh.description: 完成游戏一次后，从标题画面进入 Ultimate Challenge。这里使用模式提供的等级、技能与装备，不直接沿用战役背包；无法召唤幻影同伴，也不能在这里获取 Mastery 成长。

en.title: Ultimate Challenge: modes and rewards
en.description: Finish the game once, then enter Ultimate Challenge from the title screen. It uses mode-provided progression and equipment, with no Phantom companions or Mastery gain.

zh.title: 技能成长：熟练度、前置与投入顺序
zh.description: 角色属性等级、熟练等级、技能树前置和套装解锁是不同条件。加属性不一定能解锁技能；拿到套装技能也不代表学会了整条分支。

en.title: Skill progression: mastery, prerequisites and priorities
en.description: Character attributes, Mastery, prerequisite nodes and set-granted moves are different requirements. Attribute levels do not necessarily unlock a skill, and a set-granted move does not unlock its whole branch.

zh.title: 套装制作：专属材料与卷轴路线
zh.description: 完成“铁匠的传家宝”开放制作，再取得并登记对应卷轴。

en.title: Set crafting: special materials and scroll routes
en.description: Unlock crafting through Blacksmith’s Heirloom and register the corresponding scroll.

zh.title: 8 位鬼神：能力、成长与觉醒材料
zh.description: 鬼神能力是在魔剑的对应菜单装备、随同行成长的被动能力；幻影形态是量表变身；助力之魂是首领战前的金色召唤。三者不能混为一谈。

en.title: All eight phantoms: abilities, growth and relics
en.description: Phantom abilities are equipped passive companions that grow with use. Phantom Form is a gauge transformation; Spirit of Advocacy is the golden boss assistance summon.

zh.title: 常用消耗品：净化、抗性与战前准备
zh.description: 恢复生命、恢复战斗资源、针对本区域的净化、针对敌人的抗性或强化，分别解决不同问题。快捷栏优先放这次任务真正会用到的物品。

en.title: Consumables: cleansing, resistance and preparation
en.description: Separate health recovery, combat-resource recovery, relevant cleanses and resistance or enhancement items. Put what this mission needs on shortcuts.
